lines.text: Boaz sits at the gate, gathers ten elders, and tells the nearer kinsman-redeemer that Naomi is selling Elimelech's land, and he says he will redeem it.
The kinsman-redeemer says redeeming would jeopardize his own inheritance, so he removes his sandal and tells Boaz to buy it.
Boaz tells the elders and all the people that he has acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Chilion's widow, as his wife.
The people ask the LORD to make Ruth like Rachel and Leah, and Boaz takes Ruth, who bears a son.
Boaz and Ruth name the baby Obed, who becomes the father of Jesse, the father of David.
